name: VOD Category Tidy
description: Cleans up movie and series categories for Xtream Codes apps: strips prefixes like "Movie-" and "Series-" and merges overlapping categories, and hides categories by word. Only what apps see changes; Dispatcharr keeps the provider's categories, so refreshes are unaffected.
author: johnschult

fields.label: Prefix to strip
fields.help_text: A regular expression removed from the start of category names that no merge rule covers. Empty keeps names as they are.

fields.label: Merge rules
fields.default:
Action & Adventure = Movie-Action, Movie-Adventure, Series-Action, Series-Adventure, Series-Action & Adventure
Sci-Fi & Fantasy = Movie-Sci-Fi, Movie-Fantasy, Series-Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Series-Fantasy
Kids & Family = Movie-Family, Movies-Kids, Series-Kids, Series-Family
Drama = Movie-Drama, Movie-Romance, Movie-TV Movie, Series-Drama, Series-Soap, Series-Romance
Thriller & Mystery = Movie-Thriller, Movie-Mystery, Series-Mystery, Series-Thriller, Series-Horror
Documentary = Movie-Documentary, Movie-History, Movie-War, Series-Documentary, Series-History, Series-War & Politics, Series-News
Music = Movie-Music, Movies-Concerts, Movies-Music festivals, Series-Music
Fights = UFC Main Events, Movies-UFC Fight Nights, WWE Boxing, WWE Main Event, Movies-Other Sports Replays
Specials = Movies-Netflix, Movies-HBO, Movies-Lifetime, Sports Series
fields.help_text: One line per category apps should see: "Name = Provider category, Provider category". Movie and series categories are matched by their provider names, so one line can cover both. Lines starting with # are ignored.

fields.label: Hide categories containing
fields.default: Server, CAM, Uncategorized, Arabic, Turkey, Turkish, French, Bollywood, Ramadan, Multi-Lang, Multi-Sub, Greece, Spanish, Italian, Germany, Korean, Egypt, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi, Syria
fields.help_text: Comma-separated words or phrases, matched as whole words and ignoring case, against both the provider's name and the shown name. A matching category disappears from apps along with its titles.

actions.label: Preview categories
actions.description: Show the movie and series categories apps will see with the current settings.
